title: Fire from Heaven
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks closely until the truth shows itself, and tonight a whole nation watches to see which God is real: Scout looks past a bright, loud game and chooses Heavenly Father first.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout looks closely until the truth shows itself, and on Mount Carmel everyone looked to see which God was real. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s friends want to keep playing a new game instead of going to church. The game is bright and loud and fun. Scout looks closely and asks herself what matters most. She chooses to go, and sings the first song with her whole heart. Just like Elijah, Scout learned that we choose Heavenly Father first.
